collisions.reason: traffic-island collision contract requires separate authoring review

limitations: Two full passes, opposite renderer order; results are samples, not a statistical non-regression proof.
No forced GC; JS heap includes shared runtime, renderer and vehicle resources. Geometry buffer estimates exclude textures, render targets and driver overhead.
Main-frame times include real physics and renderer CPU work, not GPU hardware timer measurements.
First-pass raw Worker arrays were live references in intermediate snapshots; Worker distributions here use only the corrected reverse-pass copied snapshots.
Sector distributions are bounded final 512 publication samples; CPU active time is separated from elapsed shader/scheduling wait.
